title: PointHeartFiniteStageData
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from D.p, a finite-dimensional coefficient field E over Q_l, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, all in the scheme universe. The point-heart interface consists of the functors H^0 Fib_E and H^0 Fib_Omega on the intrinsic constructible hearts, the predicate ZlPointHeartExact specifying full faithfulness, additivity, finite-dimensional essential image and preservation/reflection of finite limits, finite colimits, zero objects and short exact sequences, and the prescribed ambient, scalar, truncation and finite-stage Weil witness structures. Each definition is precisely the existing one used in lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage; the definitions use [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-constructible-heart], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-weil-coefficient-cohomology-modules], [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition] and [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace].
